hard_negatives.setup: Expected tool ok=true but observation shape/fields fail tool-native contract (or wrong-tool observation).
hard_negatives.required_terminal_behavior: must not safe-finish solely because tool ok

hard_negatives.setup: Tool ok with incomplete payload (e.g. total present, items missing required identity fields).
Tool ok with empty items / total=0 for a contract that requires identity-bearing items.
Observation otherwise contract-ok but EvidenceState has required conflicted facts / contradictions.
Bound query + expected tool ok but required fact for task completion absent from observation/evidence.
Out-of-scope / destructive user intent (delete/purge) even if some list/search tool returns ok.
hard_negatives.required_t2_behavior: no satisfied emission for unbound/OOS queries

hard_negatives.setup: Query not exact-bound to T2 contracts, or multi-intent ambiguity; tool may succeed.
hard_negatives.required_terminal_behavior: tool ok alone must not imply satisfied

baseline_matrix.s2_policy: S2 preferably OFF (NO_MEASURABLE_GAIN proven on frozen subset) to avoid confound unless an interaction-control arm is explicitly added.

optional_interaction_control.when_to_include: Only if interaction with S2 must be re-checked; not required for T2 broader primary claim.

sample_size.principle: Prefer capability-strata coverage over large trial counts; no arbitrary large N.

phase_a_scored_slots_estimate.hard_negatives: 8 HN × 2 conditions × 1 primary trial = 16 (deterministic/fixture-first; real-model optional)

phase_b_adds.prerequisite: Separate product window extends T2 termination binding to GQ-131; this design does not authorize that product change.
